author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
After two recent visits to the paint departments of effects shops, Adam brings back to his own workshop the technique of using fine mist spray bottles to apply weathering effects with alcohol inks. Adam demonstrates the difference between a standard spray bottle and a fine misting one, and gives a recommendation for how to store solvents to be quickly accessible at your paint station!
